question: Can a resident 4B event monitor wake capable agents earlier and more economically than fixed cadence or simple rules, without excessive false alarms?
additional_candidates: new evidence makes ongoing work unnecessary
evaluation_order: replay real prior tool traces with no learned intervention
fresh judge and bounded repair trials
adaptation only if collected outcomes support a defensible train/held-out split
metrics: monitor input tokens, inference latency and peak GPU memory
limitations: Small exploratory sample, not a confirmatory benefit claim
Injected defects must be identified as injected
Replay action accuracy is not live workflow benefit
Model confidence is not calibrated incident probability
No reward from self-reported scientific success

authority.judge: may approve a specific repair within fixed operator policy
authority.host: validate immutable grant, base hashes, paths, isolated test command and expiry before applying

recording: Retain prompts, public packets, packet hashes, decisions, failures, usage gaps, artifacts and verification receipts. Keep raw traces outside Git.

resource_amendments.reason: Transport/setup failures require a resumable transfer and local serving validation. Live account usage measured 6.77 CU/hour. Preserve the 40-CU ceiling and all per-trial limits.
